{{Quote|What are outliers?''"<br />"''That's just the name for the star systems in the Corellian Sector that are sort of small and far away from Corell itself.|[[Anakin Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="AC" />}}
The '''Outlier systems''',<ref name="AC" /> also known as the '''Outlier Worlds''',<ref name="AS" /> or simply as the '''Outliers''', was the term given to the dozens<ref name="TEGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] that were considered unimportant and far away from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="AC" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Outlier systems are so secretive they make Corellia look wide open. Lots of people from the sector's Imperial government ran off to them and just dropped out of sight.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="AC" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] redrew the boundaries of the [[Duro sector/Legends|Duro sector]], thus making [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] part of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="CatCW" /> However, despite its position at the edge of the Corellian [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] was not considered an Outlier [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEGPM" />
